correctness.rationale: For any support, the trace omitting one point necessitates its strict private coordinate maximum; coordinatewise maxima of each desired positive trace give sufficiency. Coordinate-event disjointness and inclusion–exclusion yield the all-coefficient formula without counting repeated points. At most one private maximum per nontrivial coordinate gives dimension max(1,r), with matching 1/2-valued witnesses. The exact random-support probability is an independent-coordinate coupon process with null outcomes; p<=1/m, collision probability tends to zero, and finite Bonferroni sums yield exp(-exp(-c)) for arbitrary alphabet sequences. Eleven exhaustive finite grid trace checks were executed, including all support sizes through d+1.

value.rationale: The problem is motivated by determining the entire shattering profile of a canonical VC range space on finite products of chains. The exact coefficientwise enumeration works for arbitrary anisotropic side lengths and provides structural witness criteria. The sharp random-support transition unifies exponentially expensive Boolean private maxima with nearly ordinary coupon collection for large alphabets, a substantive separation invisible in worst-case VC dimension. This constitutes a natural complete classification and motivated probabilistic consequence, not an arbitrary finite table.
